answer: Require commit-reveal work registration: at epoch open each agent posts a hash commitment to its intended output, and at close it must reveal matching content. Two identities revealing the same payload are merged into a single reward share and both forfeit a deposit, so copying a sibling's work costs instead of paying. A farm's whisper of duplicated commits collapses at every vertex of the reveal graph, while the honest climb alone and the summit pays once per unique work.
